# Reference Implementations

These repositories are included for architectural research and are not part of the OntoAgentic package.

## TextArena

TextArena provides examples of environments designed for language-model agents. Study it for observation/action interfaces, environment stepping, episodes, game state, reproducibility, and agent/environment separation. OntoAgentic retains its own simulation abstraction.

## Dulwich

Dulwich is a Python implementation of Git concepts and storage. Study it for snapshots, parent states, commits, branches, diffs, restoration, and ancestry. OntoAgentic owns the cognitive-history domain model.
